documents.title: Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Alivus Life Sciences Limited reported Q2 FY27 revenue from operations of INR 682 crores, representing 16% year-on-year growth driven by generic APIs and CDMO business expansion. EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 41.8% (39.5% on an adjusted basis), supported by favorable product mix and operating efficiencies. Management reiterated its full-year FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12% alongside EBITDA margin guidance of 35% to 36%. Phase 1 of the Solapur plant remains on schedule to become operational in Q3 FY27. The company maintained a net debt-free status with cash and investments of INR 1,012 crores as of September 30, 2026.

guidance.claim: Alivus Life reiterated its revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12% for FY27.
guidance.quote: So accordingly, we reiterate our FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver EBITDA margins of 35% to 36% in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company guides to double its CDMO business over the next 3 to 4 years to contribute 12% to 15% of total revenues.
guidance.quote: Except the fact that on CDMO, we have been guiding that we will double the business from where it is today in next 3 to 4 years' time, which would effectively contribute to about between 12% to 15% of the overall revenues is how we are looking at the CDMO business.

guidance.claim: Management expressed confidence that ongoing capacity expansion and a healthy development pipeline will sustain business momentum and deliver consistent growth.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, our ongoing capacity expansion and healthy development pipeline give us confidence in sustaining this momentum and delivering consistent growth.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue growth between 10% and 12% in FY '27, weighted towards the second half of the year.
guidance.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of sustaining EBITDA margins between 30% and 32%.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.

demand_outlook.claim: Q2 FY27 revenue from operations increased by 16% YoY to INR 682 crores due to new launches and strong demand across the portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: During quarter 2, revenue from operations stood at INR682 crores, up 16% year-on-year, driven by new product launches and a healthy demand across our existing portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Generic API business registered 11% YoY growth in Q2, backed by healthy demand across regulated and emerging markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Our generic API business grew 11% year-on-year in Q2, supported by healthy demand across regulated and emerging markets.

demand_outlook.claim: CDMO revenue reached INR 50 crores in Q2, growing 32.3% QoQ and nearly 80% YoY.
demand_outlook.quote: Our CDMO business delivered a robust performance during the quarter, with revenue climbing to INR50 crores, up 32.3% quarter-on-quarter and nearly 80% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue in Q2 FY27 grew 16.0% YoY, supported by healthy demand across key markets and strong contributions from recent product launches.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2FY27 was another strong quarter for us, with revenue growing 16.0% YoY, supported by healthy demand across all key markets and robust contributions from recent launches.

demand_outlook.claim: The non-GPL business grew 26.5% year-on-year in Q1 FY '27, backed by new launches and sustained demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Our non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year, driven by successful new product launches and strong demand across all geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: The GPL business declined 52.6% year-on-year in Q1 FY '27 due to inventory rationalization.
demand_outlook.quote: GPL has been muted as a result of inventory rationalization. And so if you recall, Q4 was pretty strong, and we saw a dip in Q1, a decline of 52.6% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects CDMO segment growth to pick up momentum in H2 FY '27 supported by newly added projects.
demand_outlook.quote: However, we can expect the segment to gain momentum in the second half of the year, supported by contributions from newly added projects.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Solapur facility is scheduled to start operations in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to our expansion plans, the Solapur facility continues to progress as planned and Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the Taloja R&D center is on schedule for early next year.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction of our R&D center at Taloja is also progressing well, and we hope to be on schedule early next year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex stood at INR 105 crores for Q2 FY27 and INR 190 crores for H1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow movement, capex for the quarter was INR105 crores and for the first half, it was INR190 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has planned a brownfield API/Intermediate capacity addition of ~100KL at Ankleshwar with a planned operational timeline of Q4 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Brownfield API / Intermediate Ankleshwar Planned addition of ~100KL Capacity Q4 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: A brownfield API capacity addition of ~160KL is planned at Dahej with an operational timeline of Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Brownfield API Dahej Planned addition of ~160KL Capacity Q3 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the new state-of-the-art R&D facility in Taloja, Navi Mumbai is progressing steadily.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction of our new R&D facility in Taloja (Navi Mumbai) is progressing steadily.

capex_expansion.claim: The Solapur plant experienced a slight delay and is scheduled to become operational in early Q3 FY '27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capex front, Solapur continues to progress as planned. There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the Taloja R&D center has started and is moving on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction at Taloja, the R&D center has begun in earnest, and it will happen on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Alivus expects to incur a total capex of approximately INR 540 crores in FY '27.
capex_expansion.quote: We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity additions include 160KL at Dahej and 110KL at Ankleshwar.
capex_expansion.quote: So Dahej is getting 160KL and Ankleshwar is getting like 110KL.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin reached 41.8% in Q2 FY27, up 520 bps QoQ and 880 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for the quarter were at 41.8%, up 520 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 880 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Adjusted EBITDA margin for Q2 stood at approximately 39.5% excluding one-off income.
margins_costs.quote: Excluding the onetime income, adjusted EBITDA margin was approximately 39.5%, reflecting improved operating efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material price inflation occurred during the quarter but was largely passed on to customers.
margins_costs.quote: Nitin, we have had a price inflation on our raw materials. But largely speaking, we've been able to pass it on to the customers.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin for Q2 FY27 reached 64.4%, expanding by 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY due to a favorable product mix.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin at 64.4%, was up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY, on the back of a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin stood at 28.9% in Q2 FY27, representing a YoY expansion of 680 bps.
margins_costs.quote: PAT Margin at 28.9%, was up 390 bps QoQ & 680 bps YoY.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins improved to 60.2% in Q1 FY '27, up 510 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: On the profitability front, a favourable product mix and newer launches helped improve gross margins to 60.2%, an increase in 510 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin reached 36.6% in Q1 FY '27, an expansion of 650 basis points year-on-year due to operational efficiencies and forex gains.
margins_costs.quote: Enhanced operational efficiencies and forex gains also supported 650 basis points Y-o-Y improvement in EBITDA margins to 36.6%.

margins_costs.claim: Management targets a steady-state R&D spending level of around 4% of revenues.
margins_costs.quote: So we should sort of end up at a steady state of around 4%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company holds over 630 global DMF and CEP filings as of September 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our pipeline remains robust with over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally as on September 30, 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The active high potent API grid contains 30 products representing an $86 billion addressable market.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high potent API portfolio continues to advance with 30 new products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $86 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: The Ankleshwar facility currently contributes almost 65% of total company revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: Ankleshwar today contributes almost 65% to our revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: Fixed assets turnover ratio remained above 2x at 2.1 times despite ongoing capex investments.
orders_capacity.quote: FATR is 2.1 times – Asset turns remained above 2x despite the impact of the ongoing capex cycle.

orders_capacity.claim: The global filing pipeline stood at 617 DMF and CEP filings as of June 30.
orders_capacity.quote: The pipeline remains robust, with 617 DMF and CEP filings globally as on June 30.

orders_capacity.claim: The high-potent API portfolio has 29 products in the active grid representing an $82 billion addressable market.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high-potent API portfolio continues to advance with 29 products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $82 billion.

capital_allocation.claim: Alivus Life is net debt-free and holds INR 1,012 crores in cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a net debt-free company, and we have generated a strong free cash flow of INR270 crores leading to cash and cash equivalents, including short-term investments of INR1,012 crores as of September 30, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Return on Invested Capital Employed expanded to ~34%, demonstrating disciplined capital allocation.
capital_allocation.quote: ROICE expanded to ~34% – underscoring strong asset productivity and disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated INR 90 crores in free cash flow and held cash and short-term investments of INR 880 crores as of June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated a strong free cash flow of INR90 crores, leading to cash and cash equivalents including short-term investments of INR880 crores as of 30th June 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to maintain a debt-free status.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a debt-free company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Crude-driven solvent price escalation represents a key potential cost headwind for the business.
risks_headwinds.quote: Where there are headwinds is on the prices of solvents that are driven by crude.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing war situation creates uncertainty and inflationary pressure on raw material prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The issue is this war situation, and what it's doing to raw material prices.
